source_caption_text:
Travis Scott went to buy “Yeezus” and came home with a Mac Miller album instead 😭💿

Back in 2013, Travis headed to the store looking for Ye’s new album, only to find out they didn’t have a copy. He picked up Mac’s “Watching Movies with the Sound Off” instead , and ended up loving what he heard.

Both projects arrived on June 18, 2013. Imagine walking into a record store that day and having to decide which album you were taking home. Two completely different sounds, both giving people plenty to argue about on the ride back. 🔥

For Mac, “Watching Movies” captured him exploring a more introspective, experimental direction. For Ye, “Yeezus” was loud, abrasive, and willing to challenge everything listeners expected from him. Years later, both albums still mean a lot to the people who grew up with them.

Travis went in to support Ye and left with a new appreciation for Mac. A pretty good outcome for an unsuccessful shopping trip. 🙏
